visual.general_description: Black-and-white line graph of the percent change from baseline in parenteral nutrition volume and calories over six years.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background line chart. The y-axis is labeled "% Change from baseline" with ticks from 20% down to -100% in steps of 20%. The x-axis is labeled "Time course" with ticks Baseline, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years, 4 years, 5 years and 6 years. The legend below shows a solid line with filled circles for "PN volume" and a dashed line with open circles for "PN calories". Both series start at 0% at Baseline, rise to about +15 to +17% between the 1 year and 2 years ticks, then fall: at 2 years volume is about -18% and calories about +2%, at 3 years about -21% and -17%, at 4 years about -48% and -35%, at 5 years about -66% and -57%, and both reach -100% at 6 years. There are no printed data labels, patient names or panel letters.

visual.general_description: Black-and-white line graph of height and weight z scores from baseline to 6 years.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background line chart. The y-axis is labeled "Z-score" with ticks 1.5, 1, 0.5, 0, -0.5 and -1. The x-axis is labeled "Time course" with ticks Baseline, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years, 4 years, 5 years and 6 years. The legend below shows a solid line with filled circles for "Height" and a dashed line with open circles for "Weight". Height starts near 1.15 at Baseline, falls to about 0.5 within the first year, is about 0.3 at 1 year, crosses weight near zero between 1 and 2 years, then stays between about 0.2 and 0.45 to 6 years. Weight starts near 0.3, dips to about -0.85 at 1 year, rises to about 0 between 1 and 2 years, is about -0.3 at 2 years, then ranges between about -0.15 and 0.3 to 6 years. There are no printed data labels, patient names or panel letters.
